about: « Mémoire partagée », per agent, at the bottom of its page, and the defaults for an agent on an outside model (Alex 23/11: « on construit et on met un pop-up explicatif quand c'est un modèle externe : la mémoire partagée et le Carnet sont désactivés par défaut pour un modèle connecté »; passation-pro briefs/status-shared-memory.md). The bridge keeps it (bridge-rs/src/agent_shared_memory.rs, outside_model.rs, shared_memory.rs) and tells it in the agent's settings; the apps draw it (AgentPageView.swift, AgentPageScreen.kt). Read by bridge/tests_blackbox/test_shared_memory_setting.py (the bridge's answers), HermesKit AgentSharedMemoryTests and Android AgentSharedMemoryTest (what the apps read and draw). Additions only: an app 1.0 ignores `shared_memory` and draws nothing; the bridge applies the defaults and the cleaning all the same.

routes.settings: GET /v1/agents/{agent_id}/settings: + `shared_memory: {on, outside: {provider, label} | null}`; absent for an agent without the setting (other people talk to it: the family's agent, a project agent, an agent shared with a relative or linked with another household's agents; set up by hand; a profile of a Hermes the person brought). Its presence is the capability: the apps draw the switch only then.
routes.put: PUT /v1/agents/{agent_id}/shared-memory {on} → {id, on}. 404: not an agent of this place. 409 {"detail": "others_facing"}: an agent other people talk to. 400 {"detail": "by_hand"}: set up by hand, or a brought Hermes' profile. 422: no `on`, or not a boolean.
routes.file: <data>/agent_shared_memory.json (0600): {"off": [agent], "outside": {agent: {provider, label, at, off: ["shared_memory" | "notebook"]}}}. An agent absent from `off` has it on, unless it is on an outside model the bridge has not seen yet.
routes.off: Out of the shared memory's circle; what it received from the common list taken out of its USER.md (the keys the bridge wrote there; for what it received before 23/11, the common entries learnt by someone else), what it wrote itself kept; memories/.prompt-day.json removed; `memory.user_profile_enabled: false` in its profile's config.yaml; no Carnet news; no handover into its MEMORY.md; no imported facts in its USER.md; its conversations take a new prompt at their next turn (`hermes sessions refresh-prompts`). The same cleaning when it leaves the circle for any other reason (its Carnet off, shared with a relative).
routes.outside: « Modèle extérieur »: the model of its profile's config.yaml (else the hub's) is neither the person's own (an address of this machine, the local network, their Tailscale network; Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM named without an address) nor one of our European providers (EUrouter, Mistral). Then, once per provider: shared memory off and Carnet off, its in-conversation asks for the Carnet and Health not offered; at its creation, when its model changes, at the bridge's start. The person may turn them back on (the apps ask first); back on a model that is not outside, what the bridge had turned off and the person never touched comes back on.

settings.name: own_agent_default
settings.about: One of the person's own agents on our provider: on.

settings.name: outside_default
settings.about: Created on an outside model (a hub on ChatGPT through Codex): both off by default.

settings.name: outside_on_knowingly
settings.about: Turned back on by the person, knowingly: stays on.

settings.name: project_agent
settings.about: An agent other people talk to: no `shared_memory` at all.

rules.apostrophes: The texts are written with the apps' typographic apostrophe (’).
rules.where: At the bottom of the agent's page, right after « Initiative »: a small heading, one switch, one grey line under it. Nothing else on the page moves.
rules.hidden: No `shared_memory` in the settings (an app 1.1 on an older bridge, an agent without the setting): nothing drawn, not even the heading.
rules.line: The grey line says what the state does: `line_on` / `line_off`; for an agent on an outside model, `line_outside_on` / `line_outside_off` with {provider} = `outside.label`.
rules.tap: Turning it off: at once, PUT {on: false}. Turning it on for an agent on an outside model: first `confirm_title` / `confirm_text` with `confirm_on` and `confirm_cancel`; only `confirm_on` sends PUT {on: true}. Otherwise at once. The answer's `on` is kept; a failure puts the previous state back with the app's usual error line.
rules.popup: Once per agent and per provider (`outside.provider`), on this phone: when the app reads the settings of an agent with `outside` and `on` false (opening its page or its conversation), an alert `popup_title` / `popup_text` (its Carnet off too: `notebook.on` false) or `popup_text_memory` (its Carnet on), {agent} = its name and {provider} = `outside.label`, one button `popup_ok`. Never in the demo, never for an agent whose shared memory is on.
rules.demo: The demo keeps the switch on the phone (on for every agent, none on an outside model).

cases.name: outside_missing
cases.about: `outside` missing (an older 1.1 bridge): taken as null.
